picture.description: What it is, in one or two plain sentences.

mechanism.description: How it works, in a few sentences.

detail.description: The specifics: numbers, steps, fields, names. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line.

principles.description: Why it works, and why it was built this way.

example.description: Something to try, as a command or snippet.

requires.description: Concept ids this idea is built on. Each should be explained by its own card.
